title: Skate Session Consistency Before New Tricks
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skate:session
| stats avg(landed_pct) as landed_pct, avg(attempts) as avg_attempts, count as sessions by trick_family
| sort - landed_pct
description: Shows which trick families have the consistency base to justify pushing for something harder.
value: Progress usually stalls when new tricks are layered on top of foundations that are not stable yet.
implementation: Track skate sessions with trick family, attempts, and landed percentage; compare consistency by trick family.
visualization: Table of trick families with landed percentage and attempt volume.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which skate fundamentals are consistent enough to build harder tricks on next.
